name: Patients
overview: Scripture emphasizes the virtue of patience as a fruit of the Spirit, highlighting longsuffering alongside love, joy, and peace (Galatians 5:22). Patience is demonstrated through a gentle and soft answer that can turn away wrath and prevent strife (Proverbs 15:1, 18). Jesus warns against anger without cause, underscoring the importance of controlling our temper to avoid judgment (Matthew 5:22). Believers are called to seek God earnestly and be transformed by renewing their minds, enabling them to discern and live out God's perfect will, which includes bearing the fruit of patience (Matthew 7:7; Romans 12:2).
